raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The pinned `SGLANG_KERNEL_NPU_TAG` still points at `2026.9.0.post6`, so NPU CI and
release images build against an outdated SGLang NPU kernel wheel. This bumps the tag
to the latest `2026.9.0.post9` release.

## Modifications

- Bump the default `SGLANG_KERNEL_NPU_TAG` from `2026.9.0.post6` to `2026.9.0.post9`
  in `scripts/ci/npu/npu_ci_install_dependency.sh` and `docker/npu.Dockerfile`.
- Update the corresponding `build-args` in the `release-docker-npu` and
  `release-docker-npu-nightly` workflows so the released images use the same tag.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable — version pin bump only, no model or kernel code changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable — version pin bump only, no performance-relevant changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

- Verify that the PR meets the merge criteria by following the [Review Process](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#review-process).
- After the PR is approved, follow the [Merge Process](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#merge-process).

files.patch:
@@ -83,7 +83,7 @@ jobs:
           provenance: false
           sbom: false
           build-args: |
-            SGLANG_KERNEL_NPU_TAG=2026.9.0.post6
+            SGLANG_KERNEL_NPU_TAG=2026.9.0.post9
             CANN_VERSION=${{ matrix.cann_version }}
             DEVICE_TYPE=${{ matrix.device_type }}

@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@ ARG TORCH_NPU_VERSION="2.10.0.post6"
 ARG TORCH_NPU_INDEX_URL="https://ascend.devcloud.huaweicloud.com/pypi/simple/"
 ARG SGLANG_TAG=main
 ARG ASCEND_CANN_PATH=/usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit
-ARG SGLANG_KERNEL_NPU_TAG=2026.9.0.post6
+ARG SGLANG_KERNEL_NPU_TAG=2026.9.0.post9
 ARG PIP_INSTALL="python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir"
 ARG DEVICE_TYPE
 ARG MODELSCOPE_VERSION=""
